to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including histoty, clinical findings, .investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 22 year old female farmer by occupation resident of nalgonda came to hospital with a cheif complaint of bilateral lower limb swelling and facial puffiness decreased urinary output and SOB since 5 months\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENow patient admitted for renal biopsy\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of present illness;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 5 months back then she developed facial puffiness and peri orbital swelling preceded by bilateral limb swelling\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient develops SOB while she walking for small distance,sometimes at resting position\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient complaints of decreased urinary output\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of fever before the development of symptoms.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient took the treatment at nalgonda private hospital for same reason\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient admitted in our hospital for same complaints in November.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENow symptoms are subsided and now patient admitted for renal
